## Changed
- Internal packaging metadata (`pack.mcmeta`) now declares the correct resource and data pack formats for Minecraft 1.21.4. The previous values were carried over from a different Minecraft version.

## Notes
- **Nothing changes for players** — this build behaves identically to v2.2.6. No new features, no gameplay changes.
- The old values worked in practice, because Minecraft does not enforce pack formats for mod-bundled resources. This corrects them so the mod keeps working if that ever changes.
